highlights: Missing or unreadable tracks can now be repaired by choosing a replacement audio file without losing metadata, playlists, artwork, lyrics, or listening history.
Cloud snapshots compress full-resolution local artwork so large libraries can finish syncing instead of exceeding the server payload limit.
Ignifire for Web restores the complete catalog and clearly distinguishes streamable tracks from audio files that still need repair.
notes: Adds safe local-and-cloud track replacement, prevents oversized artwork from blocking cloud catalog snapshots, and restores partial web libraries with accurate streamability status.
